verdict.rationale: Front-door access is a fair axis for a public government service portal, so it applies here, but the probes show it fails. The ANEF host returns only a ~3 KB JavaScript shell that yields under 200 characters of text to a keyless agent. The parent ministry site, which hosts the guidance, returns HTTP 403 behind a Cloudflare challenge. Both are exactly the JS-only shell and bot wall the story rules out.
